mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.password_setup_email_verification (user_id, secret_hash, expires_at) VALUES(#{userId}, #{secretHash}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT verification_id, secret_hash, failed_attempts, expires_at, used_at FROM public.password_setup_email_verification WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, verification_id DESC LIMIT 1
